SDK declarations and types from pret/pokediamond, retrieved for source-level reconstruction and independently compiled against Mario Kart DS EUR. No ROM binaries or game assets are included.

Reference: https://github.com/pret/pokediamond

Imported functions are accepted only after fresh compilation of the installed source and complete original-byte equality. Preliminary signature searches are not matching proofs.

Checkpoint 33 also pins ARM7 declarations from arm7/lib/include at the same
recorded donor commit. Only independently audited C function bodies count.
